ns2:section.sectionText: Section 2--Topic: Television News Studio Production. Enroll in one lab section only. This class will meet at the Richmond Journalism Teaching Studio, located at Main and Goodwin in Urbana. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. Students who enroll in more than one Discovery course may be dropped from the additional Discovery courses. For course descriptions, see the Discovery Program booklet.
